dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are structurally smooth and symmetrical, with no observable bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse dark-pixel clusters, primarily localized around the blowhole and along the midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between subtle variations in dark-grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One high-contrast dark point at the blowhole site; one faint, thin linear mark of lighter contrast on the posterior-right dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Clear topological depression at the blowhole; longitudinal shadow-casting along the central axis indicating a raised dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a faint diagonal linear mark on the right posterior dorsal surface.
